factor_id: # Niche factors: industry revenue / cost / investment drivers (analyst reference data). side = revenue | cost | investment; earnings_sign = +1 if a higher value raises the industry's earnings, -1 if it lowers them; gics = GICS industry (6-digit), industry group (4) or sub-industry (8) codes, ';'-separated (seeds/gics.csv). Macro factors drive them through seeds/factor_links.csv; questions can also link to them directly through seeds/entity_factors.csv.

name: Drilling rig count
definition: Active oil and gas rigs (Baker Hughes): drilling and completion activity

name: Upstream capital spending
definition: E&P capital budgets that buy drilling, completion and offshore services

name: Oilfield service pricing
definition: Day rates and service pricing (offshore rigs, frac fleets, equipment)

name: Service fleet utilization
definition: Share of rigs, frac fleets and vessels working

name: Oil and gas production volume
definition: Barrels of oil equivalent produced per day

name: Realized oil price
definition: Price received per barrel after differentials and hedges

name: Realized gas price

name: Lifting cost per BOE
definition: Lease operating expense per barrel of oil equivalent

name: Well decline rates
definition: How fast output from existing wells falls (drilling needed to stand still)

name: Drilling and completion cost
definition: Cost per well (rigs, frac, steel, sand)

name: Royalties and production taxes
